## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      8 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 12 may 2026 - 3 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _njbrandon_, 3 ago 2026, 2/5: "Interactions 😔 for notes do not work. Reached out to fix but no response. When the little face icon is selected to bring up intersections for a note, shows “No results found” so need to reply instead. Also when notification is selected, doesn’t always open the task card. Few months back this was totally broken but eventually was fixed but now it’s sometimes broken. Progress"
            2. _JadedMind_, 23 jul 2026, 2/5: "I can no longer log into this app on my phone, which makes it useless. No matter what I click, including contacting support, I get a message saying it can’t connect to the server. I don’t have this issue with any other app on my phone."
            3. _guymanstuff_, 9 jul 2026, 3/5: "Can you please list in the release notes what you are actually fixing instead of just “we are making the app awesome for you” or “bye bye bugs”?"
